title: Inspect the artifact download branches
description: You trace the directory check and exception handler in the download helper.

steps.description: You import shutil and Path, then try to load Colab's files helper. The import sits inside the same try block as the download.
You check for artifacts before making artifacts.zip. An existing folder leads to the download call; the other branch prints a missing-folder message.

steps.question: What happens when the download helper raises an exception?
steps.answer: The except block catches it and prints the helper-unavailable message with its exception text.

steps.description: You see the exception handler's output in the recording. It identifies google.colab.files.download as unavailable in code-viz.
